entries.title: Psalms 76:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Neginoth. A Psalm. Of Asaph. A Song.> In Judah is the knowledge of God; his name is great in Israel,

entries.title: Psalms 76:2
segments: In Salem is his tent, his resting-place in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 76:3
segments: There were the arrows of the bow broken, there he put an end to body-cover, sword, and fight. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 76:4
segments: You are shining and full of glory, more than the eternal mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 76:5
segments: Gone is the wealth of the strong, their last sleep has overcome them; the men of war have become feeble.

entries.title: Psalms 76:6
segments: At the voice of your wrath, O God of Jacob, deep sleep has overcome carriage and horse.

entries.title: Psalms 76:7
segments: ¶You, you are to be feared; who may keep his place before you in the time of your wrath?

entries.title: Psalms 76:8
segments: From heaven you gave your decision; the earth, in its fear, gave no sound,

entries.title: Psalms 76:9
segments: When God took his place as judge, for the salvation of the poor on the earth. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 76:10
segments: The...will give you praise; the rest of...

entries.title: Psalms 76:11
segments: Give to the Lord your God what is his by right; let all who are round him give offerings to him who is to be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 76:12
segments: He puts an end to the wrath of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
